name: app-assistant-app-on-giant-ghost-wordmark-with-gradient-arc
title: Home-assistant app screen with a gradient arc over a huge pale 'Niva' wordmark
whatItIs: A cream cover with a giant pale 'Niva' behind a phone showing a greeting, a question 'How can I help you today?', action chips and an input with an orange-blue gradient arc and a blue mic button.
whatItMeans: Warm and calm; the ghost name and glowing arc make an assistant feel gentle.
techniques: Set a huge low-contrast wordmark behind the phone.
Use a warm gradient arc as the AI glow.
Present actions as small white chips.

vocabulary.definition: A large faint name behind content.
A curved blurred glow near the input.
A small pill for a suggested action.
